title: Fastned - Genesis GV70 (Electrified) 77,4 kWh (2022+) charge graph
notes: Charge graph embedded in the Fastned vehicle page (GV70 77,4 kWh (2022+), charger class 300), one kW value per SoC %, read with curl. Page carries no reuse terms and the Fastned terms of use have no clause on vehicle chart data (owner confirms). Fastned says curves assume a battery near 30 C.
